Shared shapes, getters and code literals are reuse evidence, not source-specific acceptance.
Verify status duration/expiry, cast timing, stun/curse suppression and lethal-hit target boundaries.
rawInterpretationFindings: Spell payloads use data and RawData; outer metadata may describe a troop. Verify payload.Id == troop.SpellId == outer.Id.
Execute every SpellStep in raw order, without a damage-first assumption.
Reject or flag unsupported counters, boost, choice, summon, board effects and random amount operations.
6209/6217/6219/6229/6546 require particular attention to raw status ordering.
RandomPrefNotPrevEnemy is a preference with fallback, not a guarantee of distinct targets.
Trait shape grouping and code literals do not establish acceptance.

parameterizedOracleProposal.recommendation: Use one bounded independent raw interpreter with source parameter rows for both families: 21 primary plus 6 selector extensions; preserve every ordinary trait.
parameterizedOracleProposal.independenceBoundary: Expected values read rawSpell/rawTroop/rawTrait and frozen inputs, without production prototypes, scaling, target resolvers or passive compilation.
pipeline: Validate raw spell identity and supported operations.
Derive effective Magic independently, including opening/cast hook timing.
Execute all originalStep entries in order, retaining target caches, FromPrevious, ResetTargets, Delay and living-unit boundaries.
Retain existing amountOracle witnesses and rounding expressions unchanged; fixed amounts have multiplier zero.
Resolve raw selectors using frozen randomness and explicit ties/fallback/death handling.
Keep status application, immunity and expiry separate; status Amount=1 is not automatically duration one.
Require matching native trait codes/parameters plus source-specific witnesses before reusing a shape.
